opportunities.title: SSHole: The OpenSSH Bug That Went From Patch to Pwned in Under a Day
opportunities.why_now: OpenSSH rushed patches for the 'SSHole' auth bypass and attackers already gained root on a honeypot within hours of disclosure.

opportunities.title: Root Access via Really Long Password: The musl Linux Bug That Breaks Auth With Brute Length
opportunities.why_now: A newly disclosed musl libc flaw lets attackers get root simply by slamming the system with an overly long password string, a bizarrely simple privilege-escalation path.
opportunities.angle: Technical deep-dive/explainer on the bug mechanics plus a quick checklist for which distros/services ship musl and need patching
